project_type: Next.js 16 / React 19 app with Solana Kit 8, Python market agent as separate CLI, TypeScript throughout
language: TypeScript (app), Python 3 (market agent in welp/ package), JavaScript (.mjs test files)
build_system: npm 11.17.0 / Next.js 16.4.2. Turbopack is used for the build (next.config.ts has turbopack config). Native @next/swc-win32-x64-msvc binding must be intact — a corrupt .node binary causes the entire build to fail. No .bin directory in node_modules after a partial install (npm install --prefer-offline restores it).
test_framework: Node.js built-in test runner via --experimental-strip-types for .mjs tests; Python unittest for Python tests
test_command: npm run test:paper ; npm run test:notifications ; npm run test:vault-client ; python -m unittest discover -s tests -v
verification_instructions: 1. Run `npm run lint` — expect 0 errors, 0 warnings. 2. Run `npm run typecheck` — expect 0 errors. 3. Run `npm run test:paper` — expect 4/4 pass. 4. Run `npm run test:notifications` — expect 4/4 pass. 5. Run `npm run test:vault-client` — expect 3/3 pass. 6. Run `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v` — expect 16/16 pass. 7. Run `npm run build` — expect exit 0.
snapshot_or_generated_files: .next/ directory is generated by npm run build. Run `npm run build` to regenerate.
environment_constraints: Windows 11 / PowerShell. Use `;` not `&&` to chain commands. Rust/cargo is NOT available on Windows native — WSL is blocked. Do NOT attempt Rust checks. npm ci may time out; use `npm install --prefer-offline` if node_modules/.bin is missing. The `eslint` binary won't work unless npm install restores node_modules/.bin first. Run all npm commands with `cmd /c "cd /d REPO && npm run ..."` pattern.
contribution_requirements: Do NOT enable mainnet fund movement. Do NOT commit .env, keypairs, or secrets. Follow the milestone sequence in WELPUP_BUILD_BLUEPRINT.md. Keep execute_swap fail-closed. All checks must pass before push/deploy.
key_patterns: Test files are .mjs using `import assert from 'node:assert/strict'` and `import test from 'node:test'`. They import from `../lib/FILE.ts` using --experimental-strip-types. The paper-bots.test.mjs pattern is the template. Lib files use named exports in TypeScript. No vitest or jest — use Node's built-in test runner only.
directory_structure: app/ — Next.js route pages; components/ — React UI components; lib/ — shared TypeScript library code (paper-bots.ts, vault-client.ts, devnet-client.ts, etc.); tests/ — test files (.mjs for Node runner, .py for Python unittest); welp/ — Python market agent package; programs/ — Rust/Anchor Solana programs (NOT to be built on Windows native); .agents/tasks/ — plan artifacts (NOT committed)
